## Tours with a Nazca Lines flight: how to include the excursion on a journey through Peru

**The main point when choosing a Nazca Lines itinerary is to distinguish the flight duration from the time needed for the whole outing.** The [geoglyph scenic flight](/peru/nazca-lines-and-ballestas-islands/nazca-lines-flight/) is listed as lasting 35 minutes. That is time in the air, not a full day including transfers, check-in and the return.

Here you will find {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} with the possibility of flying over Nazca. [Peru in Eight Days](/peru/tour/peru-8-days/) combines Lima, Cusco, Machu Picchu and Lake Titicaca. The Nazca flight appears as a separate excursion module associated with a free day in Lima. When choosing a specific option, you must therefore confirm its inclusion in the price and schedule rather than treating it as a mandatory activity on every version of the trip.

The [Nazca Lines](/peru/place/nazca-lines-and-ballestas-islands/) lie on the desert plain of Peru's southern coast. Enormous drawings of animals and people, together with geometric lines, belong to the archaeological heritage of Nazca and Palpa. From the air, it becomes possible to appreciate the scale of figures that are difficult to judge from the ground.

## What the flight offers and what to expect

During the flight, you may see the monkey, hummingbird and spider geoglyphs, among other images. They are viewed from a small aircraft. Beyond the archaeological interest, the experience has characteristics of its own: altitude, turns to show the figures and limited time over the plateau.

This outing appeals to travelers for whom the ancient cultures of Peru are as important as [Machu Picchu](/peru/place/machu-picchu/) and [Cusco](/peru/place/cusco/). Land-based excursions in the Andes are independent of the scenic flight and should be compared by their own days and terms.

| Option | What to check |
|---|---|
| Nazca Lines flight | Airfield, time in the air and bad-weather contingency |
| Marine excursion | Paracas port, boat and birdwatching |
| Combined outing | Both activities and a long overland transfer |

If you are interested only in marine wildlife, see [tours including the Ballestas Islands](/peru/paracas/paracas-ballestas-islands-tour/tour/). To combine a boat and an aircraft, there is a [separate Paracas–Nazca excursion](/peru/paracas/peru-paracas-nazca-full-day/) and a [catalog of tours including that complete excursion](/peru/paracas/peru-paracas-nazca-full-day/tour/). These are different products, and their terms should not automatically be considered equivalent.

## Coordinating the flight with a multi-day tour

The [eight-day Peru itinerary](/peru/tour/peru-8-days/) involves frequent transfers between [Lima](/peru/place/lima/), the Andes and the [Lake Titicaca region](/peru/place/puno-and-lake-titicaca/). It makes sense to treat the scenic flight as a separate addition to this program. The key questions are specific: where does the transfer begin, how long does it take to reach the airfield, on which day is the flight scheduled and is there enough time before the next departure?

Weather can affect both visibility and whether the flight operates. Avoid placing the excursion within a tight chain of international connections without a buffer. For travelers who are sensitive to small-aircraft flights, comfort during the aerial portion also matters. The meeting point, boarding procedure, operator restrictions and alternatives in case of postponement are agreed for the actual travel date.

## Checking the price

Compare the flight terms with the sequence of days on your chosen multi-day tour. They are different parts of the offer. Before payment, confirm whether the flight itself, the transfer to the airfield, possible charges and additional stops are paid for separately. The mere mention of an excursion on a free day does not establish that every one of these items is already included.

You can compare duration and the main itinerary components in the [Peru tours catalog](/peru/tour/). Read more about the history and geography of the geoglyphs on the [Nazca place page](/peru/place/nazca-lines-and-ballestas-islands/); the focus here is on fitting the flight into your holiday without conflicting with other scheduled days.

## Frequently asked questions about tours with a Nazca flight

### Are 35 minutes enough to visit Nazca?

The stated 35 minutes refers to the flight itself. Transfers, pre-flight preparations and the return journey add extra time. A trip from Lima requires considerably more time overall.

### Is the flight included in the price of the eight-day tour?

The flight is listed as a separate excursion module on [Peru in Eight Days](/peru/tour/peru-8-days/). Check whether it is actually included and paid for in your selected offer; a free day should not automatically be treated as a prepaid aviation excursion.

### Can Nazca be combined with the Ballestas Islands?

Yes. This combination is offered as a [separate Paracas, Ballestas and Nazca excursion](/peru/paracas/peru-paracas-nazca-full-day/). It has its own route and package of activities, which should be agreed separately from the shorter scenic flight.
